title: Margin-protective repricing — 41 SKUs · +$9.7K/mo
narrative: Realify proposes the slate and waits. Nothing is written to a channel, and the auto-revert guardrail cannot arm until you approve.

approve.blocked_reason: Approval happens at the decide stage.

approve_selected.blocked_reason: Approval happens at the decide stage.

modify.blocked_reason: Modification is not available at this stage.

send_back.blocked_reason: Sending back is not available at this stage.

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

policy.label: Target CM uplift
policy.note: Per month, portfolio-wide. The slate as proposed clears it by $0.7K.

policy.label: Max volume loss
policy.note: Predicted units, per SKU. Adjustable on Decide — it is the lever that sizes the slate.

policy.label: Confidence floor
policy.note: Below this a SKU may only go out as a test, never as a roll.

roles.name: Tested · low sensitivity
roles.note: Measured elasticity, no Buy Box exposure. Roll straight out.

roles.name: Tested · Buy Box sensitive
roles.note: Raise in two or three steps so Buy Box share can be read between them.

roles.name: Prior only · thin history
roles.note: Category prior, not a measured curve. Realify wants a read before a roll.

roles.name: Contract-constrained
roles.note: Headroom exists but MAP ceilings take most of it. Small moves only.

agents.name: Pricer
agents.role: Sizes the move per SKU and writes each channel in parity-safe order.

agents.name: Controller
agents.role: Governs. Holds the loss tolerance, the MAP ceilings and the revert guardrail.
